blind_answer.reason: Explicit categorical criteria (flag only when line items differ from the stated total by more than one cent, and ignore date formats) directly target the observed false positives. Making the field required (A) only forces a true/false decision on every invoice and does nothing to reduce false positives. Stressing that accuracy is critical (B) is a vague appeal that does not change what counts as inconsistent. Confidence-based filtering (D) is unreliable compared with specific rules (4.1-K1, 4.1-K2).
